# Templates

Canonical templates live under [`ops/03_templates/`](../../ops/03_templates/).

| Template | Use when |
|----------|----------|
| [playbook-template.md](../../ops/03_templates/playbook-template.md) | Creating or normalizing a playbook |
| [audit-template.md](../../ops/03_templates/audit-template.md) | Structured audit findings |
| [proposal-template.md](../../ops/03_templates/proposal-template.md) | Client or internal proposals |
| [research-report-template.md](../../ops/03_templates/research-report-template.md) | Market, user, or technical research |
| [competitor-teardown-template.md](../../ops/03_templates/competitor-teardown-template.md) | Competitor deep-dives |
| [project-handoff-template.md](../../ops/03_templates/project-handoff-template.md) | Handoff packages |
| [decision-log-template.md](../../ops/03_templates/decision-log-template.md) | Decision records |

New playbooks should start from the playbook template per [Adding a playbook](../../ops/00_governance/adding-a-playbook.md).
